prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

LEFT: ONE real adult Hawaiian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold hammer head, a gold pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop with a heavy rough lead a small flared temple bell hanging at its end, and four to six layered silver necklaces.
